blocked-okeechobee-county-us-441-n-forme.why: This is the same project as ft-1777315563905-2542 ('Okee-One', 7200 US-441, Okeechobee). Note for whoever merges: the kept row's status 'cancelled' would be better as 'blocked', since a county vote killed it ('Commissioners voted to strip the Special Technology Opportunity Centers designation ... closing the land-use route'), and its capacity could take this row's 10 MW ('The college told WPTV it envisaged a 9 to 10MW facility').
